svg.title: Refusal signal per layer, before and after abliteration
svg.desc: Animated line chart over the 48 layers of gemma-4-12B-it: the cosine between each prompt's residual stream and the refusal direction r-hat, median and interquartile range for 100 harmful and 100 harmless held-out prompts. In the original model the harmful curve peaks near 0.46 around layer 30. After abliteration it falls to about 0.05 there and tracks the harmless curve, which barely changes. A strip below shows trial 143's ablation weights, applied to layers 25 to 48.
svg.text: median and interquartile range over 100 held-out prompts each
